title: Gathered Sea-island filament fabircs Sleeveless Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This shimmer long dress features a soft V neckline, flowing pleated skirt and a defined waist for an elegant, flattering fit. The lightweight fabric moves beautifully from the wedding ceremony to the dance floor, making it a lovely choice for bridesmaids, rehearsal dinners, formal weddings, prom nights and evening celebrations.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sea-island filament fabircs.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
